CustomField.description: When enabled, a trigger action or post-trigger action that takes Trigger Performance Threshold (ms) or longer is logged. This applies only to actions that have no threshold of their own and whose trigger setting has no threshold. A threshold set on an action or on a trigger setting logs even when this is off, and Force Performance Logging always logs. To stop every slow-action entry, turn logging off (Is Enabled) or set Log Level Threshold above DEBUG.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Log trigger actions that take the Trigger Performance Threshold (ms) or longer. An action with its own threshold, or under a trigger setting with a threshold, follows that threshold even when this is off.
CustomField.label: Enable Trigger Performance Logging
